note: Repaint v4 2026-10-22 (s04 pkg2): close view of the cellar's back tasting bar. Knight with V shield, closed whisky bottle with key, untouched cigar on its box beside a toy car, bartender catching champagne foam in a pan, parrot on rum barrel, yak in cone hat, mouse with corkscrew, cider and halved apple, gourmet tasting cheese, adult grape-picker crew. Nobody drinks or smokes; no children. All masculine, right of divider. No on-image links: the strip Back is the single control to the cellar.

items.label: le vignoble
items.scene: A NOBLE knight with a big V on his shield (vee-NYOBL) stands guard beside a painting of his hillside VINEYARD.

items.label: le whisky
items.scene: The WHISKY bottle on the bar wears a big brass KEY on a tartan ribbon: whis-KEY (wees-KEE)! It stays closed.

items.label: le cigare
items.scene: A fat CIGAR lies untouched on its cedar box, and a little red toy CAR is parked beside it: SEE the CAR (see-GAHR)!

items.label: le champagne
items.scene: The bartender pops the CHAMPAGNE and catches the gushing foam in a frying PAN: sham-PAN (shahn-PAHNY)!

items.label: le rhum
items.scene: A red parrot perched on a little RUM barrel squawks 'ROAM! ROAM!' (ROM) as if it wants to sail away.

items.label: le cognac
items.scene: A shaggy YAK in a party CONE hat (koh-NYAHK: CONE-YAK) stands guard over the candle at the brandy end of the bar.

items.label: le tire-bouchon
items.scene: A little mouse leans back and TUGS a big CORKSCREW: tire (pull) + bouchon (cork) = teer-boo-SHOHN.

items.label: le cidre
items.scene: An apple cut in half beside the CIDER bottle shows off its SEEDS (SEEDR).

items.label: le gourmet
items.scene: A plump GOURMET, napkin tucked in, savours a bite of GOOey cheese with his eyes closed: GOO-MAY (goor-MEH).

items.label: le cru
items.scene: A CREW (KRU) of grape-pickers with baskets of grapes proudly packs bottles of their famous VINTAGE into a crate.
